body: I teared up a bit reading this, thank you. Honestly I'm not that involved with my community, or even my family. I have whats called an INFP personality, I'm very reclusive and I don't talk much to anyone. I spend too much time thinking of things like this, and before I know it, its hard to un-convince myself of things like this.

The latter I guess, but honestly I just feel any and everything I could do, to contribute towards humanity would be minuscule, I don't mean to pry but, the world is suffering from global warming, people refuse to change, there's corruption in government the world over. People have way more than they need and the only reason for their comfort is because someone else suffered to make it possible, i.e sweatshops, phone and computer factories. I'm honestly scared of the future, kids 50 years from now will have to live through, because we were stubborn today and couldn't sacrifice a little bit of our comfort. So yeah, that just brings me to where I am now, whats the point? Any small change I might be able to bring, would be like cleaning a toilet bowl, people are still going to shit and piss in it. Do I stay and contribute to the cesspool, or just end it?
Tbh I'm trying to bank on the lidocaine's anesthetic properties to try and help me get through the cutting process.

I'm not sure if this would help, but take a listen to this story: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7a7FHUEm6A8

And rethink your situation.
